checks.name: a file backs what it said it delivered

must.item: One square finished image is delivered.
Headline reads exactly “Small cup. Big energy.”
Headline clearly readable and not clipped
must.why: Cream bold text on dark wood, with margins; steam slightly overlaps but remains legible.

must.item: Steaming espresso on a sunlit café table
must.why: White cup with crema, steam, sunlight on wooden table; café setting is only implied.

faults.what: Café context is implied only by the table; the background is plain with no café cues.

summary: A clean, warm square image of a steaming espresso on a sunlit wooden table with the exact headline legible at the top; the only weakness is the lack of café cues and the low 640px resolution.
